capabilities.title: State with a stable identity
capabilities.explanation: A covenant ID can follow one application lineage while each successor UTXO commits to its new state. Consensus controls lineage entry; the script controls the transition.

capabilities.title: Constrain the exact next outputs
capabilities.explanation: A covenant can inspect and restrict the outputs it authorizes, including amounts, scripts, state, and covenant bindings.

capabilities.title: Let independent state progress in parallel
capabilities.explanation: Applications can split state across several UTXOs so unrelated transitions do not spend one global state cell.

capabilities.title: Change several actors atomically
capabilities.explanation: Each participating covenant validates its obligation in one transaction, so the combined state change succeeds or fails together.

capabilities.title: Validate another application's transition
capabilities.explanation: Argent can bind imported actor templates and observe another covenant's authenticated input and required successor.

capabilities.title: Delegate a narrow authority
capabilities.explanation: A controlling covenant can require a delegated action to obey recipient, amount, continuation, and budget rules rather than granting the delegate the whole wallet.

capabilities.title: Bond an action to time and outcome
capabilities.explanation: Scripts can combine signatures, transaction constraints, and DAA or time conditions for release and refund paths.

capabilities.title: Verify a supported zero-knowledge proof
capabilities.explanation: Toccata exposes a ZK verification opcode. It verifies the supplied proof relation; it does not independently establish an external-world fact.

capabilities.title: Export an inspectable application artifact
capabilities.explanation: Argent emits generated SilverScript and portable artifact metadata describing actors, entries, routes, witnesses, and interfaces.

capabilities.title: Separate build, VM, node, and observed evidence
capabilities.explanation: A reproducible workbench can show which stage actually passed and retain missing or failed stages rather than presenting one undifferentiated success state.
